sql:
WITH ExcellenceRate AS (
    SELECT 
        s.cds,
        s.sname AS SchoolName,
        s.NumTstTakr,
        s.NumGE1500,
        (s.NumGE1500 * 1.0 / s.NumTstTakr) AS ExcellenceRate
    FROM 
        satscores s
),
PovertyClassification AS (
    SELECT 
        f.CDSCode,
        f.`School Name`,
        f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` AS PovertyRate,
        CASE 
            WHEN f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` > 75 THEN 'High Poverty'
            WHEN f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` > 50 THEN 'Medium Poverty'
            WHEN f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` > 25 THEN 'Low Poverty'
            ELSE 'Very Low Poverty'
        END AS PovertyClassification
    FROM 
        frpm f
    WHERE 
        f.School IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
    e.SchoolName,
    p.PovertyClassification,
    s.Phone,
    s.City,
    s.Charter
FROM 
    ExcellenceRate e
JOIN 
    schools s ON e.cds = s.CDSCode
JOIN 
    PovertyClassification p ON e.SchoolName = p.`School Name`
WHERE 
    e.ExcellenceRate IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 
    e.ExcellenceRate DESC
LIMIT 3

WITH ExcellentSATSchools AS (
    SELECT 
        s.cds,
        s.sname,
        s.dname,
        s.cname,
        s.enroll12,
        s.NumTstTakr,
        s.AvgScrRead,
        s.AvgScrMath,
        s.AvgScrWrite,
        s.NumGE1500,
        s.AvgScrRead + s.AvgScrMath + s.AvgScrWrite AS TotalAvgScore,
        s.NumGE1500::real / s.NumTstTakr * 100 AS ExcellenceRate,
        f.`County Name`
    FROM 
        satscores s
    JOIN 
        frpm f ON s.cds = f.CDSCode
    WHERE 
        s.ExcellenceRate > 30
),
HighestFRPMSchoolPerCounty AS (
    SELECT 
        f.`County Name`,
        MAX(f.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)`) AS MaxFRPMRate
    FROM 
        frpm f
    GROUP BY 
        f.`County Name`
)
SELECT 
    es.cds,
    es.sname,
    es.dname,
    es.cname,
    es.TotalAvgScore,
    es.ExcellenceRate,
    f.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)`
FROM 
    ExcellentSATSchools es
JOIN 
    frpm f ON es.cds = f.CDSCode
JOIN 
    HighestFRPMSchoolPerCounty h ON f.`County Name` = h.`County Name` AND f.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)` = h.MaxFRPMRate
ORDER BY 
    es.ExcellenceRate DESC, 
    f.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)` DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH MagnetSchools AS (
    SELECT 
        s.cds,
        s.rtype,
        s.sname,
        s.dname,
        s.cname,
        s.enroll12,
        s.NumTstTakr,
        s.AvgScrRead,
        s.AvgScrMath,
        s.AvgScrWrite,
        s.NumGE1500,
        f.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)` AS PovertyLevel
    FROM 
        satscores s
    JOIN 
        frpm f ON s.cds = f.CDSCode
    WHERE 
        s.rtype = 'S' AND
        f.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 0 AND
        f.Magnet = 1 AND
        s.NumTstTakr > 500
),
TotalAverageSAT AS (
    SELECT 
        cds,
        rtype,
        sname,
        dname,
        cname,
        enroll12,
        NumTstTakr,
        AVG(AvgScrRead + AvgScrMath + AvgScrWrite) AS TotalAverageSATScore
    FROM 
        MagnetSchools
    GROUP BY 
        cds, rtype, sname, dname, cname, enroll12, NumTstTakr
),
Ranking AS (
    SELECT 
        *,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY TotalAverageSATScore DESC) AS Rank
    FROM 
        TotalAverageSAT
)
SELECT 
    r.cds,
    r.rtype,
    r.sname,
    r.dname,
    r.cname,
    r.enroll12,
    r.NumTstTakr,
    r.TotalAverageSATScore,
    r.Rank,
    m.PovertyLevel
FROM 
    Ranking r
JOIN 
    MagnetSchools m ON r.cds = m.cds
ORDER BY 
    r.TotalAverageSATScore DESC

WITH SchoolDetails AS (
    SELECT 
        s.COUNTY,
        s.SCHOOL,
        s.ENROLLMENT_K12 AS TotalEnrollment,
        f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` AS FRPMPercentage,
        f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` / s.ENROLLMENT_K12 * 100 AS FreeMealEligibilityRate,
        f.`Charter School (Y/N)` AS CharterStatus,
        ss.AvgScrRead,
        ss.AvgScrMath,
        ss.AvgScrWrite,
        (ss.AvgScrRead + ss.AvgScrMath + ss.AvgScrWrite) AS TotalSATScore,
        CASE 
            WHEN f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` >= 75 THEN 'High'
            WHEN f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` BETWEEN 50 AND 75 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Low'
        END AS FRPMCategory
    FROM 
        schools s
    JOIN 
        frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
    LEFT JOIN 
        satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds AND s.SCHOOL = ss.sname
    WHERE 
        s.ENROLLMENT_K12 > 500
        AND (f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` > 60 OR ss.NumGE1500 / ss.NumTstTakr * 100 > 30)
),
RankedSchools AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNTY,
        FRPMCategory,
        SCHOOL,
        TotalEnrollment,
        FreeMealEligibilityRate,
        CharterStatus,
        TotalSATScore,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY COUNTY ORDER BY TotalEnrollment DESC) AS EnrollRank,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY COUNTY, FRPMCategory ORDER BY TotalSATScore DESC) AS SATRank
    FROM 
        SchoolDetails
)

    COUNTY,
    FRPMCategory,
    SCHOOL,
    TotalEnrollment,
    FreeMealEligibilityRate,
    CharterStatus,
    TotalSATScore,
    EnrollRank,
    SATRank
FROM 
    RankedSchools
ORDER BY 
    COUNTY,
    EnrollRank,
    SATRank

WITH FreeMealData AS (
    SELECT 
        s.CDSCode,
        s.School,
        f.`Academic Year`,
        f.`Enrollment (K-12)` AS Enrollment,
        f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` AS FreeMealCount,
        f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` AS FRPMMealCount,
        s.Charter,
        AVG(s.AvgScrRead) AS AvgReadScore,
        AVG(s.AvgScrMath) AS AvgMathScore,
        AVG(s.AvgScrWrite) AS AvgWriteScore,
        CASE 
            WHEN f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` > 600 THEN 'Very High'
            WHEN f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` > 500 THEN 'High'
            ELSE 'Moderate'
        END AS FreeMealCategory
    FROM 
        frpm f
    JOIN 
        schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
    WHERE 
        s.County = 'Los Angeles' 
        AND f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` > 500 
        AND f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` < 700
    GROUP BY 
        s.CDSCode, s.School, f.`Academic Year`, s.Charter, FreeMealCategory
),
AverageFreeMealPercentage AS (
    SELECT 
        CDSCode,
        AVG(`Free Meal Count (K-12)` / `Enrollment (K-12)` * 100) AS AvgFreeMealPercentage
    FROM 
        frpm
    WHERE 
        `Academic Year` = '2013-14' 
        AND `County Name` = 'Los Angeles' 
        AND `Free Meal Count (K-12)` > 500 
        AND `FRPM Count (K-12)` < 700
    GROUP BY 
        CDSCode
),
CharterVsNonCharter AS (
    SELECT 
        FreeMealCategory,
        SUM(CASE WHEN Charter = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS CharterCount,
        SUM(CASE WHEN Charter = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS NonCharterCount
    FROM 
        FreeMealData
    GROUP BY 
        FreeMealCategory
)
SELECT 
    fmd.FreeMealCategory,
    fmd.AvgFreeMealPercentage,
    cvnc.CharterCount,
    cvnc.NonCharterCount,
    cvnc.CharterCount + cvnc.NonCharterCount AS TotalSchools,
    AVG(fmd.AvgReadScore) AS AvgReadScore,
    AVG(fmd.AvgMathScore) AS AvgMathScore,
    AVG(fmd.AvgWriteScore) AS AvgWriteScore
FROM 
    FreeMealData fmd
JOIN 
    AverageFreeMealPercentage afmp ON fmd.CDSCode = afmp.CDSCode
JOIN 
    CharterVsNonCharter cvnc ON fmd.FreeMealCategory = cvnc.FreeMealCategory
GROUP BY 
    fmd.FreeMealCategory

    SELECT 
        s.CDSCode,
        s.School,
        s.County,
        s.StatusType,
        s.OpenDate,
        s.Enrollment (K-12) AS Enrollment,
        f.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)` AS FRPM_Percentage,
        f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` AS FRPM_Full_Percentage,
        ss.AvgScrRead,
        ss.AvgScrMath,
        ss.AvgScrWrite,
        ss.NumTstTakr,
        ss.NumGE1500,
        (ss.NumGE1500 * 1.0 / ss.NumTstTakr) AS Excellence_Rate
    FROM 
        schools s
    JOIN 
        frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
    JOIN 
        satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
    WHERE 
        s.FundingType = 'Directly funded'
        AND s.County = 'Stanislaus'
        AND s.StatusType = 'Active'
        AND s.OpenDate BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2005-12-31'
),
CountyAverage AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG(`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)`) AS Avg_FRPM_Percentage,
        AVG(`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)`) AS Avg_FRPM_Full_Percentage,
        AVG(AvgScrRead) AS Avg_AvgScrRead,
        AVG(AvgScrMath) AS Avg_AvgScrMath,
        AVG(AvgScrWrite) AS Avg_AvgScrWrite,
        AVG(NumGE1500 * 1.0 / NumTstTakr) AS Avg_Excellence_Rate
    FROM 
        DirectlyFundedSchools
)
SELECT 
    ds.*,
    c.Avg_FRPM_Percentage,
    c.Avg_FRPM_Full_Percentage,
    c.Avg_AvgScrRead,
    c.Avg_AvgScrMath,
    c.Avg_AvgScrWrite,
    c.Avg_Excellence_Rate
FROM 
    DirectlyFundedSchools ds
CROSS JOIN 
    CountyAverage c
ORDER BY 
    ds.FRPM_Full_Percentage DESC,
    ds.Excellence_Rate DESC

WITH OldestFemaleClient AS (
    SELECT client_id
    FROM client
    WHERE gender = 'F'
    ORDER BY birth_date ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
LowestSalaryDistrict AS (
    SELECT district_id, MIN(A11) AS min_salary
    FROM district
    GROUP BY district_id
),
ClientAccount AS (
    SELECT d.client_id, a.account_id
    FROM disp d
    JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE d.client_id = (SELECT client_id FROM OldestFemaleClient)
)
SELECT 
    c.client_id,
    a.account_id,
    ds.min_salary,
    (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district) - ds.min_salary AS salary_gap
FROM ClientAccount a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN LowestSalaryDistrict ds ON d.district_id = ds.district_id

WITH VirtualSchools AS (
    SELECT 
        s.CDSCode,
        s.School,
        s.County,
        s.Virtual,
        s.Charter,
        f.`Enrollment (K-12)` AS Enrollment,
        f.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)` AS FreeMealPercentage,
        ss.AvgScrRead,
        ss.AvgScrMath,
        ss.AvgScrWrite,
        ss.NumTstTakr,
        ss.NumGE1500
    FROM 
        schools s
    JOIN 
        frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
    LEFT JOIN 
        satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds AND s.School = ss.sname
    WHERE 
        s.Virtual IN ('F') 
        AND s.County IN ('San Diego', 'Santa Barbara')
),
VirtualSchoolStats AS (
    SELECT 
        County,
        COUNT(*) AS VirtualSchoolCount,
        SUM(CASE WHEN Charter = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS CharterSchoolCount,
        SUM(CASE WHEN Charter = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS RegularSchoolCount,
        AVG(Enrollment) AS AverageEnrollment,
        AVG(FreeMealPercentage) AS AverageFreeMealPercentage,
        AVG(ss.AvgScrRead) AS AverageAvgScrRead,
        AVG(ss.AvgScrMath) AS AverageAvgScrMath,
        AVG(ss.AvgScrWrite) AS AverageAvgScrWrite,
        MAX(Enrollment) AS LargestEnrollment
    FROM 
        VirtualSchools
    GROUP BY 
        County
)
SELECT 
    County,
    VirtualSchoolCount,
    CharterSchoolCount,
    RegularSchoolCount,
    AverageEnrollment,
    AverageFreeMealPercentage,
    AverageAvgScrRead,
    AverageAvgScrMath,
    AverageAvgScrWrite,
    LargestEnrollment,
    MAX(CASE WHEN Enrollment = LargestEnrollment THEN School ELSE NULL END) AS LargestSchoolName
FROM 
    VirtualSchoolStats
ORDER BY 
    VirtualSchoolCount DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH SalaryDistricts AS (
    SELECT d.district_id
    FROM district d
    WHERE d.A11 BETWEEN 6000 AND 10000
      AND d.district_id IN (
          SELECT district_id
          FROM (
              SELECT district_id, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY A3 ORDER BY A11 DESC) as salary_rank
              FROM district
          ) subq
          WHERE salary_rank <= 3
      )
      AND (
          SELECT COUNT(*)
          FROM client c
          WHERE c.district_id = d.district_id AND c.gender = 'F'
      ) >= 5
),
ActiveLoans AS (
    SELECT l.account_id
    FROM loan l
    WHERE l.status = 'A'
)
SELECT 
    d.district_id,
    d.A2 AS district_name,
    COUNT(c.client_id) AS female_client_count
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN SalaryDistricts sd ON d.district_id = sd.district_id
JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN ActiveLoans al ON a.account_id = al.account_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
GROUP BY d.district_id
ORDER BY female_client_count DESC
LIMIT 3

WITH WeeklyStatements AS (
    SELECT a.client_id
    FROM account a
    WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
),
ClientInfo AS (
    SELECT 
        ws.client_id,
        c.gender,
        d.A3 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) + 0 < 1990 THEN 'Senior'
            WHEN strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) + 0 BETWEEN 1990 AND 2000 THEN 'Middle-aged'
            ELSE 'Young'
        END AS age_group
    FROM WeeklyStatements ws
    JOIN client c ON ws.client_id = c.client_id
    JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
)
SELECT 
    gender,
    age_group,
    region,
    COUNT(*) AS count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_income,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_expense
FROM ClientInfo ci
LEFT JOIN trans t ON ci.client_id = t.account_id
GROUP BY gender, age_group, region
ORDER BY gender, age_group, region

WITH FemaleClients AS (
    SELECT 
        c.client_id,
        c.birth_date,
        a.date AS account_opening_date,
        a.account_id,
        l.loan_id,
        l.status
    FROM 
        client c
    JOIN 
        disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
    JOIN 
        account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
    LEFT JOIN 
        loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
    WHERE 
        c.gender = 'F' 
        AND strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) < '1950'
        AND c.district_id = (SELECT district_id FROM district WHERE A2 = 'Sokolov')
)
SELECT 
    AVG(julianday('now') - julianday(f.birth_date)) / 365 AS avg_age_at_account_opening,
    COUNT(DISTINCT f.account_id) AS total_accounts,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN f.status = 'A' THEN f.account_id END) AS successfully_completed_loans,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN f.status = 'D' THEN f.account_id END) AS currently_in_debt,
    MIN(strftime('%Y', f.account_opening_date)) AS earliest_year,
    MAX(strftime('%Y', f.account_opening_date)) AS latest_year
FROM 
    FemaleClients f

```sql
FROM 
    client c
JOIN 
```
    district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id

    MostPopulatedDistrict md ON d.A2 = md.A2

WITH DisponentClients AS (
    SELECT d.client_id
    FROM disp d
    WHERE d.type = 'DISPONENT'
),
PostTransactionAccounts AS (
    SELECT a.account_id
    FROM account a
    WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
),
ClientLoanStats AS (
    SELECT c.client_id,
           COUNT(l.loan_id) AS total_loans,
           SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_loans,
           SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed_loans
    FROM client c
    JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
    JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
    LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
    GROUP BY c.client_id
),
ClientTransactions AS (
    SELECT c.client_id,
           SUM(TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(t.amount), 1, LENGTH(TO_CHAR(t.amount)) - 2), '999999')) AS total_transactions
    FROM client c
    JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
    JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
    GROUP BY c.client_id
),
ClientCreditCards AS (
    SELECT c.client_id,
           COUNT(card.card_id) AS num_cards
    FROM client c
    JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.disp_id
    JOIN card ON d.disp_id = card.disp_id
    GROUP BY c.client_id
)
SELECT dc.client_id,
       cl.total_loans,
       cl.active_loans,
       cl.completed_loans,
       ct.total_transactions,
       cc.num_cards
FROM DisponentClients dc
JOIN ClientLoanStats cl ON dc.client_id = cl.client_id
JOIN ClientTransactions ct ON dc.client_id = ct.client_id
JOIN ClientCreditCards cc ON dc.client_id = cc.client_id
ORDER BY ct.total_transactions DESC

    c.gender,
    AVG(a.balance) AS avg_account_balance,
    COUNT(*) AS total_gold_cardholders
FROM 
    client c
JOIN 
    disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN 
    card ca ON d.disp_id = ca.disp_id
JOIN 
    account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE 
    ca.type = 'gold' AND
    a.balance > 1000 AND
    d.type = 'OWNER'
GROUP BY 
    c.gender

WITH DecinAccounts AS (
    SELECT 
        strftime('%Y', date) AS year,
        strftime('%m', date) AS month,
        COUNT(*) AS DecinCount
    FROM 
        account
    WHERE 
        district_id = (SELECT district_id FROM district WHERE A2 = 'Decin')
        AND strftime('%Y', date) = '1993'
    GROUP BY 
        year, month
),
TotalAccounts AS (
    SELECT 
        strftime('%Y', date) AS year,
        strftime('%m', date) AS month,
        COUNT(*) AS TotalCount
    FROM 
        account
    WHERE 
        strftime('%Y', date) = '1993'
    GROUP BY 
        year, month
)
SELECT 
    da.year,
    da.month,
    da.DecinCount * 100.0 / ta.TotalCount AS DecinPercentage,
    AVG(ta.TotalCount) OVER (PARTITION BY da.year) AS YearlyAverage,
    CASE 
        WHEN da.DecinCount * 100.0 / ta.TotalCount > AVG(ta.TotalCount) OVER (PARTITION BY da.year) THEN 'Above'
        WHEN da.DecinCount * 100.0 / ta.TotalCount < AVG(ta.TotalCount) OVER (PARTITION BY da.year) THEN 'Below'
        ELSE 'Equal'
    END AS Comparison
FROM 
    DecinAccounts da
JOIN 
    TotalAccounts ta ON da.year = ta.year AND da.month = ta.month
ORDER BY 
    da.year, da.month

WITH LoanDetails AS (
    SELECT 
        l.account_id,
        d.A2 AS district_name,
        c.gender,
        c.birth_date,
        a.district_id,
        a.frequency,
        a.date AS account_creation_date,
        l.date AS loan_approval_date,
        l.amount,
        l.duration,
        l.payments,
        l.status,

        t.balance,
        t.type,
        t.operation,
        t.amount AS trans_amount,
        t.k_symbol,
        t.bank,
        t.account
    FROM 
        loan l

        account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN 
        client c ON a.client_id = c.client_id
    JOIN 
        district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    JOIN 
        trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
),
DistrictLoanSummary AS (
    SELECT 
        district_name,
        district_id,
        AVG(A11) AS avg_salary
    FROM 
        LoanDetails
    GROUP BY 
        district_name, district_id
)

    dl.district_name,
    dl.avg_salary,
    dl.account_id,
    dl.gender,
    dl.birth_date,

    dl.interest_rate,
    dl.balance,

    dl.trans_amount,

    dl.account
FROM

WITH AccountDetails AS (
    SELECT 
        a.account_id,
        a.district_id,
        a.frequency,
        a.date AS account_open_date,
        d.A2 AS district_name
    FROM 
        account a
        JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE 
        d.A2 = 'Prachatice'
),
OwnerDemographics AS (
    SELECT 
        a.account_id,
        c.gender,
        c.birth_date,
        COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count
    FROM 
        account a
        JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
        JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
        LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
    WHERE 
        a.district_id IN (SELECT district_id FROM district WHERE A2 = 'Prachatice')
    GROUP BY 
        a.account_id, c.gender, c.birth_date
),
TransactionStats AS (
    SELECT 
        a.account_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_income,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_expense,
        COUNT(t.trans_id) AS transaction_count
    FROM 
        account a
        JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
    WHERE 
        a.district_id IN (SELECT district_id FROM district WHERE A2 = 'Prachatice')
    GROUP BY 
        a.account_id
),
LoanInfo AS (
    SELECT 
        a.account_id,
        COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count
    FROM 
        account a
        LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
    WHERE 
        a.district_id IN (SELECT district_id FROM district WHERE A2 = 'Prachatice')
    GROUP BY 
        a.account_id
),
CustomerCategory AS (
    SELECT 
        a.account_id,
        CASE 
            WHEN l.loan_count > 0 AND ts.transaction_count > 10 THEN 'High Activity'
            WHEN l.loan_count > 0 THEN 'Loan Customer'
            WHEN ts.transaction_count > 10 THEN 'Active Customer'
            ELSE 'Regular Customer'
        END AS customer_category
    FROM 
        AccountDetails a
        LEFT JOIN LoanInfo l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
        LEFT JOIN TransactionStats ts ON a.account_id = ts.account_id
)
SELECT 
    ad.account_id,
    ad.district_name,
    ad.frequency,
    ad.account_open_date,
    od.gender,
    od.birth_date,
    od.loan_count,
    ts.total_income,
    ts.total_expense,
    ts.transaction_count,
    ci.customer_category,
    ts.total_income - ts.total_expense AS net_balance
FROM 
    AccountDetails ad
    LEFT JOIN OwnerDemographics od ON ad.account_id = od.account_id
    LEFT JOIN TransactionStats ts ON ad.account_id = ts.account_id
    LEFT JOIN CustomerCategory ci ON ad.account_id = ci.account_id
ORDER BY 
    net_balance DESC

WITH account_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(account_id) AS total_accounts,
        AVG(COUNT(trans_id)) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id) AS avg_transactions_per_account,
        SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS net_balance,
        MAX(balance) AS max_balance
    FROM 
        trans
    JOIN 
        account ON trans.account_id = account.account_id
    WHERE 
        district_id = (SELECT district_id FROM district WHERE A2 = 'Pisek')
    GROUP BY 
        account_id
),
credit_card_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(DISTINCT disp_id) AS total_credit_cards_issued
    FROM 
        disp
    JOIN 
        card ON disp.disp_id = card.disp_id
    JOIN 
        account ON disp.account_id = account.account_id
    WHERE 
        district_id = (SELECT district_id FROM district WHERE A2 = 'Pisek')
),
loan_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(loan_id) AS total_loans_issued,
        SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'A' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(DISTINCT account_id) AS avg_active_loan_amount
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    WHERE 
        district_id = (SELECT district_id FROM district WHERE A2 = 'Pisek')
)
SELECT 
    account_stats.total_accounts,
    account_stats.avg_transactions_per_account,
    account_stats.net_balance,
    account_stats.max_balance,
    credit_card_stats.total_credit_cards_issued,
    loan_stats.total_loans_issued,
    loan_stats.avg_active_loan_amount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT disp_id) AS num_unique_account_owners
FROM 
    account_stats
JOIN 
    credit_card_stats ON 1=1
JOIN

WITH CommonBond AS (
    SELECT bond_type, COUNT(*) AS bond_count
    FROM bond
    GROUP BY bond_type
    ORDER BY bond_count DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
MoleculesWithBond AS (
    SELECT b.bond_type, m.label, COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) AS molecule_bond_count
    FROM bond b
    JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
    JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
    JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE b.bond_type = (SELECT bond_type FROM CommonBond)
    GROUP BY b.bond_type, m.label
),
BondStats AS (
    SELECT 
        cb.bond_type,
        cb.bond_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT mb.label) AS num_molecules,
        AVG(mb.molecule_bond_count) AS avg_bonds_per_molecule,
        COUNT(DISTINCT a.element || '-' || a2.element) AS unique_element_pairs
    FROM CommonBond cb
    JOIN MoleculesWithBond mb ON cb.bond_type = mb.bond_type
    JOIN connected c ON mb.bond_id = c.bond_id
    JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
)
SELECT * FROM BondStats

WITH AtomElementCounts AS (
    SELECT 
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2,
        COUNT(c.bond_id) AS bond_count
    FROM 
        connected c
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    GROUP BY 
        a1.element, a2.element
),
MostCommonBond AS (
    SELECT 
        element1, 
        element2, 
        bond_count
    FROM 
        AtomElementCounts
    WHERE 
        bond_count = (SELECT MAX(bond_count) FROM AtomElementCounts)
)
SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN mb.bond_count IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS REAL) AS percentage
FROM 
    bond b
CROSS JOIN 
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom) atom_count
CROSS JOIN 
    MostCommonBond mb
WHERE 
    EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 
        FROM connected c 
        JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id 
        JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id 
        WHERE a1.element = mb.element1 AND a2.element = mb.element2 AND b.bond_id = c.bond_id
    )

WITH carcinogenic_molecules AS (
    SELECT m.molecule_id
    FROM molecule m
    WHERE m.label = '+'
),
atoms_with_fluorine AS (
    SELECT cm.molecule_id, COUNT(a.atom_id) AS num_atoms_with_fluorine
    FROM carcinogenic_molecules cm
    JOIN atom a ON cm.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
    WHERE a.element = 'f'
    GROUP BY cm.molecule_id
),
atoms_without_fluorine AS (
    SELECT cm.molecule_id, COUNT(a.atom_id) AS num_atoms_without_fluorine
    FROM carcinogenic_molecules cm
    JOIN atom a ON cm.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
    WHERE a.element != 'f'
    GROUP BY cm.molecule_id
),
bonds_with_fluorine AS (
    SELECT cm.molecule_id, COUNT(b.bond_id) AS num_bonds_with_fluorine
    FROM carcinogenic_molecules cm
    JOIN connected c ON cm.molecule_id = c.atom_id OR cm.molecule_id = c.atom_id2
    JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
    JOIN atoms_with_fluorine af ON cm.molecule_id = af.molecule_id
    GROUP BY cm.molecule_id
),
bonds_without_fluorine AS (
    SELECT cm.molecule_id, COUNT(b.bond_id) AS num_bonds_without_fluorine
    FROM carcinogenic_molecules cm
    JOIN connected c ON cm.molecule_id = c.atom_id OR cm.molecule_id = c.atom_id2
    JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
    JOIN atoms_without_fluorine awf ON cm.molecule_id = awf.molecule_id
    GROUP BY cm.molecule_id
),
average_bond_strength AS (
    SELECT cm.molecule_id, AVG(CASE WHEN b.bond_type = '-' THEN 1
                                    WHEN b.bond_type = '=' THEN 2
                                    WHEN b.bond_type = '#' THEN 3
                               END) AS avg_bond_strength
    FROM carcinogenic_molecules cm
    JOIN connected c ON cm.molecule_id = c.atom_id OR cm.molecule_id = c.atom_id2
    JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
    GROUP BY cm.molecule_id
)
SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN a.num_atoms_without_fluorine IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(cm.molecule_id) AS percentage_without_fluorine,
    AVG(awf.num_atoms_without_fluorine) AS avg_num_atoms_without_fluorine,
    AVG(bwfs.num_bonds_without_fluorine) AS avg_num_bonds_without_fluorine,
    AVG(bwsf.num_bonds_with_fluorine) AS avg_num_bonds_with_fluorine,
    AVG(abs.avg_bond_strength) AS avg_bond_strength
FROM carcinogenic_molecules cm
LEFT JOIN atoms_without_fluorine awf ON cm.molecule_id = awf.molecule_id
LEFT JOIN atoms_with_fluorine af ON cm.molecule_id = af.molecule_id
LEFT JOIN bonds_without_fluorine bwf ON cm.molecule_id = bwf.molecule_id
LEFT JOIN bonds_with_fluorine bwfs ON cm.molecule_id = bwfs.molecule_id
LEFT JOIN average_bond_strength abs ON cm.molecule_id = abs.molecule_id

```sql
),
```
SingleBonds AS (
    SELECT 
        cb.bond_id,
        COUNT(*) AS single_bonds
    FROM 
        connected c
        JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
    WHERE 
        b.bond_type = '-'
    GROUP BY 
        cb.bond_id
)
SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(sb.single_bonds) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(tb.total_bonds) AS percentage_single_bonds

    TotalBonds tb

sql:
WITH AnnualSetCounts AS (
    SELECT 
        strftime('%Y', releaseDate) AS Year,
        COUNT(*) AS SetCount
    FROM 
        sets
    WHERE 
        releaseDate BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2015-12-31'
    GROUP BY 
        Year
),
LanguageCounts AS (
    SELECT 
        language,
        COUNT(*) AS LanguageCount
    FROM 
        cards
    GROUP BY 
        language
)
SELECT 
    ACS.Year AS Year,
    ACS.SetCount AS AnnualSetCount,
    LC.language AS CommonLanguage
FROM 
    AnnualSetCounts ACS
CROSS JOIN 
    (SELECT language FROM LanguageCounts ORDER BY LanguageCount DESC LIMIT 1) LC
ORDER BY 
    ACS.Year
raw:
```sql

    GROUP BY

        cards

)
```

    SELECT Id
    FROM users
    ORDER BY Reputation DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
PostsByMostInfluentialUser AS (
    SELECT p.Id
    FROM posts p
    JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
    WHERE u.Id = (SELECT Id FROM MostInfluentialUser)
),

    SELECT p.Id
    FROM posts p
    WHERE p.OwnerUserId IN (SELECT Id FROM MostInfluentialUser)
      AND p.Score > 50
)
SELECT 
    CAST(COUNT(p.Id) AS REAL) / COUNT(pb.Id) * 100 AS PercentageAbove50Score
FROM 
    PostsByMostInfluentialUser p

    PostsAbove50Score pb ON p.Id = pb.Id

sql:
WITH bad_superheroes AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS bad_count
    FROM superhero s
    JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
    WHERE a.alignment = 'Bad'
),
marvel_bad_superheroes AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS marvel_bad_count
    FROM superhero s
    JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
    JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
    WHERE a.alignment = 'Bad' AND p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
)
SELECT 
    (bad.marvel_bad_count * 100.0 / bad.bad_count) AS percentage,
    bad.marvel_bad_count AS marvel_bad_superheroes_count
FROM bad_superheroes bad, marvel_bad_superheroes marvel
raw:

    drivers d

    results r2 ON d.driverId = r2.driverId

    results r3 ON d.driverId = r3.driverId

    races r ON r2.raceId = r.raceId

    GROUP BY l.driverId
    ORDER BY MIN(CASE WHEN l.time LIKE '%:%' THEN SUBSTR(l.time, INSTR(l.time, ':')+1) ELSE l.time END) ASC
    LIMIT 1
)

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN b.event_status IN ('Open', 'Planning') AND b.category = 'Advertisement' AND e.event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff' THEN b.amount ELSE 0 END) AS yearly_kickoff_ad_budget,
    SUM(CASE WHEN b.event_status IN ('Open', 'Planning') AND b.category = 'Advertisement' AND e.event_name = 'October Meeting' THEN b.amount ELSE 0 END) AS october_meeting_ad_budget,
    (yearly_kickoff_ad_budget - october_meeting_ad_budget) / october_meeting_ad_budget AS ratio
FROM 
    budget b
JOIN 
    event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id

    b.category = 'Advertisement'
    AND (e.event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff' OR e.event_name = 'October Meeting')

WITH yearly_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        c.Segment,
        ym.Date,
        SUM(ym.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM 
        yearmonth ym
    JOIN 
        customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE 
        ym.Date LIKE '2012%' OR ym.Date LIKE '2013%'
    GROUP BY 
        c.Segment, ym.Date
),
consumption_change AS (
    SELECT 
        Segment,
        (SUM(CASE WHEN Date LIKE '2013%' THEN TotalConsumption ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN Date LIKE '2012%' THEN TotalConsumption ELSE 0 END)) AS IncreaseOrDecrease,
        SUM(CASE WHEN Date LIKE '2012%' THEN TotalConsumption ELSE 0 END) AS BaseYearConsumption
    FROM 
        yearly_consumption
    GROUP BY 
        Segment
)
SELECT 
    Segment,
    IncreaseOrDecrease,
    BaseYearConsumption,
    ((IncreaseOrDecrease / BaseYearConsumption) * 100) AS PercentageIncrease,
    CASE 
        WHEN IncreaseOrDecrease > 0 THEN 'Highest'
        ELSE 'Lowest'
    END AS IncreaseType
FROM 
    consumption_change
WHERE 
    Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
ORDER BY 
    CASE 
        WHEN IncreaseOrDecrease > 0 THEN IncreaseOrDecrease 
        ELSE IncreaseOrDecrease * -1
    END DESC,
    PercentageIncrease

WITH YearlyConsumption AS (
    SELECT 
        c.Segment,
        y.CustomerID,
        SUM(y.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM 
        yearmonth y
    JOIN 
        customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE 
        y.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
        AND c.Currency = 'CZK'
    GROUP BY 
        c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
MinConsumptionPerSegment AS (
    SELECT 
        Segment,
        MIN(TotalConsumption) AS MinConsumption
    FROM 
        YearlyConsumption
    GROUP BY 
        Segment
),
LowestConsumingCustomers AS (
    SELECT 
        Segment,
        CustomerID
    FROM 
        YearlyConsumption yc
    JOIN 
        MinConsumptionPerSegment mcp ON yc.Segment = mcp.Segment AND yc.TotalConsumption = mcp.MinConsumption
),
AnnualAverageConsumption AS (
    SELECT 
        Segment,
        AVG(TotalConsumption) AS AvgConsumption
    FROM 
        LowestConsumingCustomers lcc
    JOIN 
        YearlyConsumption yc ON lcc.CustomerID = yc.CustomerID
    GROUP BY 
        Segment
)

    'SME_LAM' AS Comparison,
    LAM.AvgConsumption - SME.AvgConsumption AS Difference
FROM 
    AnnualAverageConsumption A

    AnnualAverageConsumption LAM ON A.Segment = 'LAM'

SELECT

FROM 
    AnnualAverageConsumption A
JOIN 
    AnnualAverageConsumption LAM ON A.Segment = 'LAM'
JOIN 
    AnnualAverageConsumption KAM ON A.Segment = 'KAM'
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    'KAM_SME' AS Comparison,
    SME.AvgConsumption - KAM.AvgConsumption AS Difference
FROM 
    AnnualAverageConsumption A
JOIN 
    AnnualAverageConsumption KAM ON A.Segment = 'KAM'
